sentiment_summary: Most Skybags buyers praise the lightweight construction, smooth spinner wheels and overall value for money, with several detailed endorsements of durability and design. However, a handful of low‑star reviews report poor material quality, damaged or used‑looking bags on arrival, and outright brand disappointment, suggesting inconsistent quality control across the product line.

wheels.summary: Several reviewers praised the wheels as smooth and sturdy (e.g., “wheels are smooth and sturdy” – review 2; “wheels are smooth and quiet” – review 42), while a few noted used or less smooth wheels (e.g., “Wheels are all used and layer of dirt” – review 4; “single‑spinner wheels … could have been smoother” – review 46).

handle.summary: Positive feedback on the handle appears in review 27 (“handle system is very fine & smooth”), but other users reported weakness or breakage (e.g., “handle quality slightly weak” – review 32; “My handle got broken” – review 28).

zipper.summary: Most comments are favorable, such as “zipper quality is top notch” (review 13) and “zippers feel strong” (review 29), though a few note it could be weaker (review 46) or not ideal (review 14).

material.summary: Many reviewers highlighted durable polyester or ABS shells (“material is very good”, review 12; “ABS hard shell feels durable”, review 49), yet some complained of thin or torn plastic (“plastic was torn”, review 4; “material is somehow thin” – review 25).

size.summary: Reviews mention accurate medium dimensions (review 2, 54) and ample capacity for trips (review 18, 27), while a few note the bag being slightly smaller than advertised (review 6) or having less capacity than competitors (review 28).

durability.summary: Long‑term users report lasting condition (“using for more than 2 years and no issues”, review 33; “still in very good condition after 5 years”, review 30), whereas some experienced early damage (“could not survive the first airline trip”, review 50).

value_for_money.verdict: Customers repeatedly describe the bag as good quality and a good deal for its ₹1788 price, with comments like “worth the price” and “great value for the price”. Only occasional remarks about being a bit pricey for the capacity appear, so overall the quality justifies the budget price, yielding a strong value‑for‑money rating.
